import numpy as np


def forecast(train_series, history_windows, feature_cols, target_col, input_len, output_len):
    t = feature_cols.index(target_col)
    # Use mean of the last hour (6 steps) for recent status
    recent_power = np.mean(history_windows[:, -6:, t], axis=1)
    
    # Estimate power based on wind speed curve
    w = feature_cols.index("Wspd")
    bins = np.linspace(0, 20, 20)
    curve = train_series.groupby(np.digitize(train_series["Wspd"], bins))[target_col].mean()
    avg_wspd = np.mean(history_windows[:, -36:, w], axis=1)
    target = np.array([curve.get(i, train_series[target_col].mean()) for i in np.digitize(avg_wspd, bins)])

    diurnal_seq = np.tile(diurnal, 3)[:output_len]
    
    # Blend wind-target and diurnal
    final_target = 0.6 * target[:, None] + 0.4 * diurnal_seq
    
    # Slower decay to preserve local persistence
    decay = np.exp(-0.015 * np.arange(output_len))

    return np.clip(preds, 0.0, None)
